```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

## Loading Packages
```{r load-packages, message=FALSE}
library(tidyverse) # for data cleaning and visualizations
library(RColorBrewer) # for better colors
```

## Load Data
```{r load-data}
example <- read.csv("data/example_data.csv")
```

```{r stat-by-ma}
stat_example <- example %>% 
  select(label.x, stat_info) %>% 
  mutate(stat_info = if_else(stat_info == "" | is.na(stat_info), "No", stat_info)) %>%
  count(label.x, stat_info, name = "Count") %>%
  rename(Category = stat_info)

stat_ma <- ggplot(stat_example, aes(x = label.x, y = Count)) +
  geom_col(aes(fill = Category), position = "dodge") +
  geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(Count > 0, Count, ""), group = Category), 
            position = position_dodge(0.9), vjust = -.4, 
            family = "serif", size = 4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#9dc892", "#fb9a99", "#beaed4")) +
  labs(x = "", 
       y = "Number of Documents/Citations", 
       fill = "Reports Effect Size") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 12, family = "serif"),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12, color = "black", family = "serif"))

stat_ma

# save image
# ggsave("visuals/example_stat.png", stat_ma, device = "png", height = 5, width = 7)
```

## Effect Description

```{r effect-by-ma}
table(example$es_descrip)

esdescrip_example <- example %>% 
  select(label.x, es_descrip) %>% 
  mutate(es_descrip = case_when(es_descrip == "Other,No" ~ "No",
                                es_descrip == "Yes,Other" ~ "Yes",
                                TRUE ~ es_descrip)) %>% 
  mutate(es_descrip = if_else(es_descrip == "" | is.na(es_descrip), "No", es_descrip)) %>%
  count(label.x, es_descrip, name = "Count") %>%
  rename(Category = es_descrip)

esdescrip_ma <- ggplot(esdescrip_example, aes(x = label.x, y = Count)) +
  geom_col(aes(fill = Category), position = "dodge") +
  geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(Count > 0, Count, ""), group = Category), 
            position = position_dodge(0.9), vjust = -.4, 
            family = "serif", size = 4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#9dc892", "#fee8a9", "#beaed4")) +
  labs(x = "", 
       y = "Number of Documents/Citations", 
       fill = "Describes Effect Size") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.text = element_text(size = 12, color = "black", family = "serif"),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 12, color = "black", family = "serif"),
        axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 12, family = "serif"),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12, color = "black", family = "serif"))

esdescrip_ma

# save image
# ggsave("visuals/example_descrip.png", esdescrip_ma, device = "png", height = 5, width = 7)
```
